title: AML Escalation for Unusual Outbound Transfers
body: Escalate outbound transfers when the amount is materially above normal behavior, the counterparty is new, or the geography, timing, and channel materially differ from the customer profile.
tags: aml transfer suspicious anomaly geography counterparty

title: Customer Verification and KYC Usage
body: Verified KYC supports lower operational friction, but a verified profile does not override transaction-specific fraud or sanctions concerns.

title: Manual Review Threshold Policy
body: High-risk or low-confidence decisions must be sent to manual review instead of being automatically approved or rejected.

title: Representative Assist Guardrails
body: Internal assistants may recommend products or process steps, but final customer-facing offers must respect product eligibility, suitability, and applicable risk controls.

title: End-of-Day Reconciliation Policy
body: Back-office reporting may proceed only after reconciliation confirms that the expected totals and posted ledger totals match within tolerance. Any mismatch must open an exception case.
